children: Orange made available a slide presentation detailing 2Q 2026 results and growth strategy ahead of its Stephens Bank Forum presentation.
Distributed investor slides for Stephens Bank Forum 2026 covering operating, growth strategies and financial performance.
Reported $2.4B total deposits, $1.9B total net loans and $2.8B total assets as of 2Q 2026.
Highlighted $1.7B AUM across wealth businesses and complementary private banking offerings driving fee revenue.
Emphasized low-cost core deposit base: 98.5% core deposits, 32.7% noninterest-bearing, 96 bps deposit cost.
Presented credit metrics: 1.38% loan reserve to gross loans, $22.2M nonperforming loans (1.16% of total loans).
